title: Barrier atlas of the four target conjectures
note: Uploaded by a second agent on Tubai's command, 20 October 2026, from a read-only study of the repositories strings, seed, 4Y-M, fermat-hodge- and H8. A wall is a proved no-go result with explicit hypotheses; a breaker is a construction that violates one of them. Status: established (proved in the cited source and reread here), conditional (rests on an unproved input), proposed (a route stated here, untested), open (no known method).

hodge.statement: HC is equivalent to (F2) and (F3'); (F2) is HC for abelian varieties, (F3') says every Hodge class is reached from abelian varieties. Algebraic loci are dense and either everything or meagre.
hodge.verdict: (F2) with (F3') is the conjecture itself, so no construction removes both at once. The first instances are finite questions.

walls.statement: specialisation lifts only through semiregularity; a blow-up adds the defect of its centre; birational maps and Fourier-Mukai equivalences preserve the defect in degree 4
walls.breaker: construct a cycle outright on the variety carrying the class

walls.statement: direct sums are never semiregular
walls.hypothesis: the object is a direct sum
walls.breaker: convolutions (twisted complexes)

walls.statement: on E_0^6 the criterion dim Ext^2 = 57 fails for at most five line bundles, for six and seven, for eight outside 31 arrangements, for three powers of L and for threefold pieces of one family
walls.source: fermat-hodge-, Thm. fivebundles, Rem. sevenbundles, Prop. separated, Cor. threefolds
walls.hypothesis: few line bundles, or one family of supports
walls.breaker: eight or more line bundles, the 31 arrangements, supports mixing the two families; ranks along chains as certified exact linear algebra

walls.statement: chains of quotients by symplectic automorphisms have multiplier in {1, 2, 3, 6} modulo squares, so they reach no real multiplication outside sqrt 2, sqrt 3, sqrt 6
walls.source: fermat-hodge-, Prop. sqrt10 (Nikulin's coinvariant ranks 16 and 18)
walls.hypothesis: every correspondence is a symplectic quotient
walls.breaker: a correspondence of another kind: non-symplectic automorphisms, mixed groups

walls.statement: base change along finite subgroups of PGL_2 reaches only Q(zeta_7)^+ and Q(zeta_9)^+ with the algebra D_infinity
walls.hypothesis: the group acts on the base P^1
walls.breaker: an automorphism not fibred over P^1, or the transport map into the rank-18 family

walls.statement: composites of Hodge isometries between hyper-Kahler carriers return by +-1, and of similarities by a rational number
walls.breaker: a non-isometric correspondence; none is known

walls.statement: a Mumford fourfold has no degeneration keeping the exceptional class of Hodge type: its Hodge locus is a compact Shimura curve
walls.breaker: none

walls.statement: the link xi on X x X x Z_K is equivalent to the target together with one more cycle
walls.hypothesis: no cycle on X^r x Z_K acts on T_Z
walls.breaker: an algebraic cycle acting nonzero on T_Z; candidates at CM points from McMullen's curve (Mostaed, arXiv 2603.20268, 2816 equations)

walls.statement: very general Weil tori have Chern character exactly a Weil class, so the pure criterion (P2) is false
walls.breaker: the polarised form (P2'), whose rank is in closed form (H8, thm:p2primenumber)

routes.text: finish E_0^6 by certified brute force: quotient the configurations by the stabiliser of the CM point and by Galois, compute every rank modulo two primes, emit rank certificates (exact kernel vector plus a nonsingular minor), recheck in Lean
sweep the CM point as a parameter (E_{zeta_3}^6 and other CM types); the target 57 and the Ext dimensions change with it

Markman (arXiv 2502.03415, 2509.23403, 2509.23079) settles Weil fourfolds and split sixfolds of discriminant -1; the frontier is CM degree >= 4 off CM points, non-split eightfolds, n >= 5 and the exceptional classes; enumerate Mukai vectors on moduli of sheaves with K-action and screen against (P2')

for F = Q(zeta_7)^+ the Shimura curve of each algebra D lies in the four-dimensional period domain of the rank-18 family, whose image is a threefold; locate an intersection point numerically and certify it in ball arithmetic; a point gives (F3') at (F, D) beyond D_infinity
for each cyclic cubic field of conductor 13, 19, 31, ... search Nikulin gluings for a K3 lattice with a group action whose rational group algebra has that field as a centre and transcendental rank 9
no source of non-isometric correspondences on S_lambda x S_lambda is known beyond Kuga-Satake, and no proved Kuga-Satake case covers rank 9 with a cubic field

strings.statement: GSC holds iff there is a viable vacuum (C1)-(C9) fixed by the mirror map mu wherever mu is defined (Theorem D of strings).
strings.verdict: blocked by definition: (C7)-(C9) are fixed by comparison with measurement and are not yet mathematical statements.

walls.statement: the standard embedding gives 100/|H| net families on quintic quotients and never three on the three weighted pencils or their free quotients
walls.breaker: non-standard bundles (line-bundle sums, monads) or other Calabi-Yau threefolds

walls.statement: a (2,2) vacuum with mu(V) = V is self-mirror, so h^11 = h^21, chi = 0 and (C2) fails; with the remark on mirror pairs, GSC is equivalent to a viable vacuum outside L^mu
walls.source: argument made in the atlas; to be checked against the paper's definition of mu
walls.breaker: vacua off the standard embedding, where the mirror condition is empty

walls.statement: moduli stabilisation, the Yukawa hierarchy and supersymmetry breaking are fixed by comparison with measurement
walls.breaker: definition repair (construct/reformulate.py): each condition as an explicit inequality

walls.statement: numerical Calabi-Yau metrics (Donaldson's algorithm, neural networks) carry no certified error bound, so (C8) is checked numerically and not proved
walls.source: cymetric; Constantin, Fraser-Taliente, Harvey, Lukas, Ovrut, arXiv 2402.01615
walls.breaker: an a posteriori bound on the Monge-Ampere residual

routes.text: write (C7)-(C9) as inequalities, then scan: CICY and Kreuzer-Skarke threefolds, free quotients, line-bundle sums with c_1 = 0 (cohomCalg, pyCICY), stability as linear feasibility in the Kahler cone, index -3|Gamma|, Wilson lines, spectrum, then numerical Yukawas with error bars (cymetric)

seed.statement: the exact transition depth D_4 of the Kreuzer-Skarke list; 22 <= D_4 <= 348, D = 349 uniformly, D_2 = 5, D_3 = 11.
seed.verdict: closable by brute force with certificates.

walls.statement: a bound using only (|Delta|, |Delta*|) cannot be below the longest chain of realised pairs, 348
walls.breaker: strictly monotone invariants added as keys: the normalised volumes of Delta and Delta* (construct/volume_chain.py)

walls.statement: in dimension 3 the h*-vector is palindromic and vol Delta = 2|Delta| - 6, so the volume adds nothing
walls.breaker: in dimension 4, vol Delta = |2 Delta| - 3|Delta| + 2 depends on h_2

walls.statement: exact depth needs the maximal reflexive subpolytopes, exponential in the number of points
walls.breaker: cut chains with interval Hasse diagrams (hcert), symmetry reduction, best-first search

routes.text: finish the threshold-50 farm (11,315,601 certified, 18,681 left at the time of reading), then rerun hcert on the remainder at T = 40, 30, 22
compute |2 Delta| for the whole list on the device (the Hugging Face copy has no volume field) and run chain_bound3; the 106 polytopes with pair bound above 340 may drop without a cut search
local search over weight systems near (8,4,2,1,1) and skew bipyramids scored by the exact shortest descent on small cases
re-verify reflexivity and point counts of the certificates with Normaliz or the integer-only reflexive.py, so D_4 does not rest on PALP alone

yang-mills.statement: Hypothesis R: a positive mass gap of 4D SU(2) lattice Yang-Mills uniformly in the spacing.
yang-mills.verdict: window widening only; problems 2 to 4 of 4Y-M (crossover, continuum limit, physical gap) are the Clay problem.

walls.statement: any forest gauge leaves at least 2(d-1)(abar-1) = 12 active partners per active link on average, so single-link Dobrushin with the quarter influence stops at beta_W = 1/3
walls.breaker: blocks of links; plaquette variables with Bianchi constraints; Dobrushin-Shlosman on boxes

walls.statement: the SU(3) single-link corrector stops near beta_W = 0.77
walls.breaker: multi-link blocks

walls.statement: the gauge Dobrushin-Shlosman test needs a box of side about 90, about 2.6e8 SU(2) links
walls.breaker: rigorous bounds on small blocks instead of one large box

walls.statement: the multiscale log-Sobolev route needs convex effective potentials along the Polchinski flow; none is known for gauge fields at order-one coupling
walls.source: Bauerschmidt, Bodineau, Dagallier, Probab. Surveys 21 (2024); 4Y-M OPEN.md
walls.breaker: gauge-fix first, then prove convexity (unknown)

walls.statement: the crossover to Balaban's regime, the continuum limit with the Osterwalder-Schrader axioms and the gap in physical units
walls.breaker: none known

routes.text: blocks of 4 links (a plaquette) or the links of a unit cube; bound the Wasserstein influence of a boundary link on the conditional block law by interval quadrature on SU(2)^k with Lipschitz enclosures; check a weighted Dobrushin norm below 1 at a rational beta; verify the inequality in Lean; start at beta_W = 0.35
weighted Dobrushin and matrix-norm criteria gain only when influences vary; in the one-per-plaquette gauge every link has 12 partners, so the gain is expected to be small
enter the beta ranges of Cao, Nissim and Sheffield (arXiv 2505.16585), Shen, Zhu and Zhu (arXiv 2204.12737) and Adhikari and Cao (Ann. Probab. 2025) as calibration nodes
Faizal and Shabir (arXiv 2606.19362) claim a 4D SU(N) construction with a mass gap; unrefereed and unverified, kept out of the ledger
